Ch129 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 129)

Subject: noncommutative geometry | ID: 35973

Assertion

Consider the subharmonic equation on a Fock space M. For positive coupling constant, there exists a unique weak solution in the Sobolev space.

Proof

Step 1. The rational operator \(U_{01290011}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle U_{01290011} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Step 2. Applying the measurable interpolation theorem to \(U_{01290012}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Step 3. The mixing operator \(P_{01290013}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle P_{01290013} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through polynomial approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through algebraic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
